pickRoom: Choose a room first: the method is filed under it and the whole project can use it
intro: When a piece of work turns out well, Cheese can write it up as a method: what input it needs, which steps and rules to follow, and what to deliver. The confirmed version goes into every later room in this project; say “do one with the weekly report method” in a room to use it
changeOf: · version {revision} is in use; this is a change to it
emptyHint: After a piece of work turns out well, say “save how we did this as a method” in the room
